The '''Necr'ygor system''' was located in the [[Chommell sector/Legends|Chommell sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the origin point of the [[Necr'ygor Omic wine]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|366|Necr'ygor Omic}}</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[Necr'ygor Omic wine]]|system=Necr'ygor [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Necr'ygor [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square O-16.<ref name="TEA" />
